 2026 FCS playoffs automatic bid tracker and scenarios
 The 5 most surprising FCS football championship runs since 2000 
 Share 
 The 2026 FCS playoffs are approaching, with 11 automatic bids up for grabs.
 Eleven teams automatically qualify for this year's playoffs via conference affiliation. An additional 13 teams earn at-large bids selected by the FCS Playoff Committee.  The complete 24-team bracket  will be announced on Sunday, Nov. 22. The FCS playoffs conclude with the national championship in Nashville, Tennessee, on Monday, Jan. 11, 2027. 
 We will fill in the winner of each conference's automatic bid below as they are decided:
 CONFERENCE 
 Auto-Bid TEAM 
 Big Sky 
 CAA 
 Monmouth

 Harvard

 NEC

 Conference winners who abstain from the FCS playoffs are as follows: 
 MEAC 
 Champion:  South Carolina State 
 SWAC 
 SWAC East: TBD 
 SWAC West: TBD 
 How every team clinched an automatic bid
 Stay tuned as we'll recap how every automatic bid was clinched as they happen. 
 CAA
 Monmouth clinched the CAA auto-bid in Week 11 after Campbell lost to Elon.
 Ivy
 Harvard clinched the Ivy League auto-bid in Week 11 after the Crimson beat Penn, Princeton lost to Yale and Dartmouth lost to Cornell
 MEAC
 South Carolina State clinched the MEAC title and a Celebration Bowl berth in Week 11 after the Bulldogs beat North Carolina Central and Delaware State lost to Howard.
 MVFC
 South Dakota State clinch the MVFC auto-bid in Week 11 after beating Southern Illinois and Illinois State beat Youngstown State.
 Patriot
 Lehigh clinched the Patriot League auto-bid in Week 11 after beating Richmond and Holy Cross beat Villanova.
 UAC
 Tarleton State clinched the UAC auto-bid in Week 11 after beating West Florida.
 Clinching scenarios
 Here are the scenarios for every team that could clinch a conference title in Week 12 .
 Big Sky
 Montana State can clinch the Big Sky auto-bid if:
 Montana State beats Montana
 OR
 Montana State loses to Montana
 AND
 Weber State beats Utah Tech
 Northern Arizona beats Northern Colorado
 Montana can clinch the Big Sky auto-bid if:
 Montana beats Montana State
 AND
 Northern Colorado beats Northern Arizona
 OR 
 Northern Arizona beats Northern Colorado
 AND
 Utah Tech beats Weber State
 Montana ranks the higher in the Sagarin Ratings than Northern Arizona and Montana State
 Northern Arizona can clinch the Big Sky auto-bid if:
 Northern Arizona beats Northern Colorado
 AND 
 Montana beats Montana State
 Utah Tech beats Weber State
 Northern Arizona ranks the higher in the Sagarin Ratings than Montana and Montana State
 NEC
 Central Connecticut State can clinch the NEC auto-bid if:
 Central Connecticut State beats Duquesne
 Robert Morris can clinch the NEC auto-bid if:
 Robert Morris beats LIU
 AND
 Central Connecticut State loses to Duquesne
 LIU can clinch the NEC auto-bid if:
 LIU beats Robert Morris
 AND
 Central Connecticut State loses to Duquesne

 Southeast Missouri State can clinch the OVC auto-bid if:
 Southeast Missouri State beats UT Martin
 Western Illinois can clinch the OVC auto-bid if:
 Western Illinois beats Lindenwood
 AND
 Southeast Missouri State loses to UT Martin
 UT Martin can clinch the OVC auto-bid if:
 UT Martin beats Southeast Missouri State
 AND
 Western Illinois loses to Lindenwood

 Dayton beats Presbyterian
 OR
 Dayton loses to Presbyterian
 AND

 Valparaiso beats St. Thomas

 Butler beats Morehead State
 AND
 Dayton loses to Presbyterian
 OR

 AND

 Mercer beats ETSU
 ETSU can clinch the SoCon auto-bid if:
 ETSU beats Mercer
 Southland

 Lamar beats McNeese
 OR

 Stephen F. Austin can clinch the Southland auto-bid if:
 Stephen F. Austin beats Northwestern State
 AND
 Lamar loses to McNeese
 SWAC East
 Alabama A&M can clinch the SWAC East and a berth to the SWAC Championship Game if: 
 Alabama A&M beats Mississippi Valley State
 OR
 Alabama A&M loses to Mississippi Valley State
 AND
 Jackson State loses to Alcorn State
 Jackson State can clinch the SWAC East and a berth to the SWAC Championship Game if: 
 Jackson State beats Alcorn State
 AND
 Alabama A&M loses to Mississippi Valley State
 SWAC West
 Prairie View A&M can clinch the SWAC West and a berth to the SWAC Championship Game if: 
 Prairie View A&M beats Alabama State
 OR
 Prairie View A&M loses to Alabama State
 AND
 Southern loses to Grambling State in the Bayou Classic (after week 12) 
 OR
 Prairie View A&M loses to Alabama State
 AND
 Arkansas-Pine Bluff beats Texas Southern
 Alcorn State beats Jackson State
 Southern beats to Grambling State in the Bayou Classic
 Southern can clinch the SWAC West and a berth to the SWAC Championship Game if: 
 Southern beats to Grambling State in the Bayou Classic (after week 12) 
 AND
 Prairie View A&M loses to Alabama State
 AND
 Arkansas-Pine Bluff loses to Texas Southern
 OR
 Alcorn State loses to Jackson State

 Stan Becton joined NCAA.com in 2021 and has since served as a college football, FCS football, track and field, cross country and HBCU beat reporter. He has covered numerous NCAA championship events, including the FCS Championship, DI Track & Field Championships and Men's Frozen Four. Additionally, he has covered the College Football Playoff and HBCU sporting events like the Celebration Bowl, MEAC/SWAC Challenge and Legacy Classic. Stan graduated from Carnegie Mellon University, earning a degree in Professional Writing and playing football as a five-year letterman. You can follow him on Twitter @stan_becton .
